video_title: Michael Scotto: The Kings Target First Round Pick in Potential Sabonis Trade

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings and Hornets trade discussions involving Domantas Sabonis
quotes.excerpt: Sacramento has sought a first-round pick in any conversation that they've had regarding Domantas Sabonis.

text_blocks.speaker: Allen Stiles
text_blocks.text: If the Hornets say they're not giving it up, does that probably conclude the conversations with the Hornets and the Kings for Domantas Sabonis?

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Scotto
text_blocks.text: The full trade discussions between the Kings and the Hornets involving Domantas Sabonis going to the Hornets from Miles Bridges, Josh Green and a potential first-round pick. Sacramento has sought a first-round pick in any conversation that they've had regarding Domantas Sabonis.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis's value as a top frontcourt player
quotes.excerpt: He was one of the top frontcourt players in the league over the past three seasons.
quotes.quote: This is a guy that before last year, playing 19 games due to injuries, he was one of the top frontcourt players in the league over the past three seasons before that. So they still feel like he's got value.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings' preference for a first-round pick in trade
quotes.excerpt: Ideally if you can get a pick in this draft, which is very deep, that'd be ideal.
quotes.quote: Ideally if you can get a pick in this draft, which is very deep, that'd be ideal for Sacramento. To this point, Charlotte has pushed back on that for obvious reasons. They have two picks, 14 and 18, where they feel like they can get an impact player and add to this group.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis as an all-in move for Hornets
quotes.excerpt: Sabonis, you can make an argument is certainly one of the most talented guys they are looking at.
quotes.quote: Sabonis, you can make an argument is certainly one of the most talented guys they are looking at, and it shows that they are trying to win now.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings' concerns regarding Jakob Poeltl and Emmanuel Quickley contracts
quotes.excerpt: The Kings didn't want the long-term money and the injury concerns to Jakob Poeltl because of his back.
quotes.quote: The Kings didn't want the long-term money and the injury concerns to Jakob Poeltl because of his back. Emmanuel Quickley, who's a point guard and they kind of need a point guard, his contract they felt was too high. And so they would have sought not only a pick for Sabonis, but additional picks to assume those contracts.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan's trade value as an expiring contract
quotes.excerpt: You kind of want to move him as an expiring contract even though he's got some partially guaranteed money.
quotes.quote: You kind of want to move him as an expiring contract even though he's got some partially guaranteed money. I wouldn't just, this is me personally, I'm not Scott Perry. But if it's me, a guaranteed contract, you can always move an expiring contract. The worst come to worst, it's coming off the books in a year.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Khris Middleton as an ideal fit for Kings
quotes.excerpt: Khris Middleton would be ideal for them.
quotes.quote: Khris Middleton would be ideal for them. Do I think the Nets are going to take him? They'll look at him, but they're looking at a lot of different guards there. I'd say Michael Brown Jr. certainly, Kingston Flemings also is going to be in the mix there.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' potential move with the fifth pick
quotes.excerpt: Do the Clippers keep that pick or do they move that pick and try to pair somebody with Kawhi?
quotes.quote: The question becomes at five, do the Clippers keep that pick or do they move that pick and try to pair somebody with Kawhi? I think it'd be hard to move Kawhi while this investigation is going on.

quotes.speaker: Michael Scotto
quotes.summary_phrase: Sean Marks' history with traditional centers
quotes.excerpt: Sean Marks has never had a traditional center like that, especially let alone with the sixth pick.
quotes.quote: I could just tell you in the past, Sean Marks has never had a traditional center like that, especially let alone with the sixth pick. That would be out of character if they did that.
